concepts.note: Initial three-animal exploration; chiefly penguin and cheetah, retaining a feather crest and bird legs.
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original company mascot and AI question-asking companion for ReSpace, a room-design company. A cute invented biological creature coherently combining penguin, ostrich, and cheetah. Brand palette strictly warm white, rich purple, muted warm gold, with very dark purple eyes. Soft high-end 3D character design, tactile matte toy-like feather/fur surfaces, clear readable shapes, expressive face, beautifully lit. No robots, clothing, accessories, lettering, logos, speech bubbles, watermarks, furniture, or environment. Landscape character exploration sheet on very pale warm gray studio background: one large full-body three-quarter hero on left, two smaller full-body poses of THE SAME character on right (attentive listening and curious questioning), ample whitespace, all extremities visible. Anatomically coherent single species, two legs, two wings, one tail. Face must work as a tiny conversational avatar. DIRECTION 1, PIPPA: compact round egg-shaped penguin-leading creature, oversized rounded head flows into plump pear-shaped body, large warm dark-purple eyes in white penguin face mask, tiny rounded warm-gold beak, rich purple back and short flipper-wings. The cheetah traits are a few bold gold solid spots on the purple forehead and wings, delicate purple cheetah tear streaks under outer eye edges, a short thick gold tail with purple tip. Ostrich traits: two clearly visible medium-length slim gold bird legs with broad rounded two-toed feet and three soft upswept white crown feathers. Legs about one-quarter total height: an endearing compact waddle silhouette, no separate long neck. Primary pose gently tilts head, one wing open as if patiently asking a question; second pose wings at sides listening; third pose small delighted bounce. Charming, calm, nonjudgmental, an approachable little listener. White dominant front, purple sides, restrained gold accents. Avoid looking like a conventional black-and-white penguin or generic owl.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original cute company mascot and friendly AI question-asking companion for ReSpace. Palette strictly warm white, rich purple, and muted warm gold, dark purple eyes. Premium soft 3D character concept render, tactile matte fur/feathers, expressive and legible face, clear simple silhouette. Landscape sheet: one large full-body three-quarter hero left, two smaller full-body poses of EXACTLY SAME character right, attentive listening and curious questioning; ample whitespace on very pale warm gray studio background. All extremities visible. No text, logos, accessories, clothes, robot parts, watermarks, or props. One coherent invented species, two legs, two flipper-wings, one tail. PENGUIN + OSTRICH ONLY. Distinctly tall and lanky but still cute, small round white head on long slender softly curved S-shaped white neck, oval pear-shaped white penguin body, purple back and two short purple flipper-wings. Two long slender warm-gold ostrich legs with oversized rounded two-toed feet. A tiny flat warm-gold beak, large friendly dark-purple eyes, subtle purple penguin face-mask edging around white face, two loose upswept purple head feathers, one short fluffy purple bird tail with gold tip. Long unmarked white neck; no spots, mammal ears or cheetah tail. Thoughtful and curious, gentle slightly awkward elegance. Hero curves neck and leans down toward viewer as if asking a considerate question with one wing raised. Smaller pose straightens neck in discovery, other tilts neck while listening. Long neck and legs create tall narrow silhouette, substantially different from a round squat penguin. Soft studio light, refined animated-film quality.

Compact lithe upright white penguin pear-shaped torso with purple back, two sleek purple penguin flippers in place of arms, two short athletic white hind legs ending in oversized rounded soft gold penguin webbed feet. Long elegant flexible cheetah tail, gold with purple spots and dark-purple rounded tip. No ostrich legs, no crest, no long neck, no exposed claws or teeth. Cute expressive company companion, playful clever helpful personality, never predatory or smug. Distinct triangular energetic silhouette, gold spotted head, white torso, purple flippers, ears and long tail. Hero in dynamic welcoming mid-step, smaller pose crouched attentively, other delighted to have an idea. Clean simplified shapes and sparse spots remain readable as an avatar.
